name: Delete Custom Object Records
summary: Permanently deletes records on a custom object type, matched by the object's dedupe field (default) or Marketo GUID. Up to 300 per call.
whenToUse: When records on a custom object should be removed. There is no undo.
confirm: This PERMANENTLY deletes up to 300 records on this custom object type. This cannot be undone. Continue?

body.hint: Comma-separated key values to delete — the object's dedupe field value (e.g. VINs). Adjust if your object's dedupe field has a different name (see Describe Custom Object).

fields.name: deleteBy
fields.label: Delete by
fields.hint: If you switch to idField, paste marketoGUID values in the box instead.

response.description: Per record: marketoGUID and status (deleted or skipped with a reason).

notes: Deleting a record doesn't delete the lead it may be linked to.
